units.title: Expected Timetable
units.instruction:
Mandatory events: Hong Kong Public Offering commences
Latest time for completing electronic applications; latest time for payment; latest time for giving electronic application instructions to HKSCC
Application lists open; application lists close
Expected Price Determination Date; announcement of Offer Price
Announcement of level of applications in Hong Kong Public Offering; announcement of level of indications of interest in International Offering; announcement of basis of allocation; availability of allotment results
Dispatch or deposit of share certificates into CCASS; dispatch of refund cheques / e-refund payment instructions
Expected commencement of dealings on the Stock Exchange
Mandatory notes: all dates and times refer to Hong Kong local time; website information does not form part of the Prospectus; application list opening/closing may be affected by typhoon, black rainstorm or Extreme Conditions; share certificates become valid only if Global Offering becomes unconditional and termination rights are not exercised; trading before receipt or validation of share certificates is at investors' own risk; refund arrangements for unsuccessful or partially successful applications

units.title: Appendix I
units.instruction: Appendix I — Accountants' Report: reporting accountant letter (title; firm name/address; addressees; introduction; Track Record Period; pages covered; purpose); Directors' responsibility; reporting accountants' responsibility (standard such as HKSIR 200; ethics; reasonable assurance; no opinion on internal control effectiveness); opinion (true and fair view); interim/stub period review (negative assurance); Listing Rules / Companies Ordinance matters; historical financial information statements; notes (corporate info, basis of presentation/preparation, accounting policies, critical judgments, revenue, segment info, tax, PPE, intangibles, financial instruments, preferred shares/convertibles, share-based payments, related parties, capital management, subsequent events)

units.title: Appendix II
units.instruction: Appendix II — Unaudited Pro Forma Financial Information: opening disclaimer (not part of Accountants' Report; illustrative only); basis of preparation (Listing Rule 4.29; AG 7; transaction illustrated; assumed date); pro forma adjusted NTA table (unadjusted audited NTA; estimated net proceeds; preferred share conversion if applicable; pro forma adjusted NTA; per Share amount); Offer Price scenarios (low-end; mid-point; high-end; downward adjustment if applicable); notes (source from Appendix I; net proceeds basis; expenses; over-allotment assumption; share count; exchange rate); reporting accountant compilation report
tableRequirements: Appendix II pro forma adjusted NTA table with per-scenario Offer Price columns.

units.title: Appendix III
units.instruction: Appendix III — Summary of Constitution and Cayman Islands Company Law and Taxation: opening (summary only; full M&A available for inspection); Memorandum of Association (adoption date; limited liability; objects; powers); Articles of Association (share classes and rights; directors' appointment/removal/powers; variation of rights; general meetings; voting; proxies; transfer; repurchase; dividends; winding up; minority protection; WVR provisions if applicable); Cayman Islands company law (incorporation; share capital; mergers; minority protection; directors' duties; shareholder remedies; taxation; exchange control); taxation (Cayman treatment; stamp duty; investor tax advice disclaimer)

units.title: Appendix IV
units.instruction: Appendix IV — Statutory and General Information: A. Further information about the Company/Group (incorporation; changes in share capital; resolutions of shareholders; repurchase mandate disclosures; corporate reorganization cross-reference); B. Further information about the business (summary of material contracts with parties/dates/terms/consideration; intellectual property rights; property interests); C. Directors, management, staff, substantial shareholders and experts (disclosure of interests under SFO; service contracts and appointment letters; directors' remuneration; standard disclaimers); D. Share incentive schemes (for each: adoption date; purpose; participants; maximum shares; grant terms; vesting; outstanding grants; grantee disclosure; SFC exemption/waiver); E. Other information (litigation; no material adverse change; sponsors' independence and fee; preliminary expenses; promoter; qualifications and consents of experts; binding effect; bilingual prospectus; taxation)

units.title: Appendix V
units.instruction: Appendix V — Documents Delivered to Registrar and Available for Inspection / Display: documents delivered to the Registrar of Companies (application forms; written consents of experts; copies of material contracts); documents available for inspection/display (location/websites; availability period, usually 14 days); document list (M&A; Accountants' Report; audited financial statements; pro forma report; Cayman legal opinion; Cayman Companies Act; PRC legal opinions if applicable; industry consultant report; material contracts; expert consents; directors' service contracts; share incentive scheme rules; full grantee list if required by waiver)
